Sasha (PM): Quick check-in: we need a crisp prioritization for the next Optimize-phase: batching, prefix caching, model quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Customers asking for: 1) immediate token-cost reductions, 2) mobile P95 <100ms, 3) faster regression detection. I propose 3 priority lanes and 4 launch gates. Thoughts?

Mike (Eng): Lanes make sense. Suggest splitting batching work into: a) runtime continuous batching (server) and b) surface-level batching presets (client/SDK) so customers can opt-in safely. Runtime batching gives the most savings but needs strong tail-latency controls.

Linda (ML): For quant, we should ship recommendation profiles (safe presets) rather than automated quant on by default. Start with q4a and fp16 comparisons and produce a small matrix (latency, token-cost, quality delta) for top-3 served models. Need eval harness before any customer rollout.

Anna (Solutions): Sales wants a single sentence value prop and a one-page migration checklist for Dedicated. Also request a Console control: "Conserve tokens / Balanced / Low latency" presets and example config snippets for customers.

Tom (SRE): Ops constraints: any batching change must have a canary path plus automated circuit-breakers. Add dashboard tiles: per-route token-cost, P95/P99, and eval-alert-rate. Define rollback triggers (e.g., P99 increase > 30% or eval-alert rate > 1%).

Sasha (PM): Draft launch gates (minimal): 1) Quant profiles and perf matrix for top-3 models + docs; 2) Server-side batching policy with canary + SLO override; 3) Prefix caching opt-in and correctness tests; 4) Eval-alert prototype + runbook and customer integration guide. Keep gates small so we can ship incrementally.

Mike (Eng): We'll add measurable acceptance thresholds in the spec: token reduction target for cost lane (RetailCo baseline 30% target), P95 ceiling for latency lane (<100ms mobile), and allowed eval-metric delta (per-customer). I'll sketch values in the tech spec.

Linda (ML): Recommend per-customer relative thresholds (e.g., task-specific accuracy delta <2%) and a human-in-the-loop spot-check flow for initial weeks. Avoid global metrics like BLEU.

Anna (Solutions): I'll map 4 pilot customers to lanes (RetailCo = cost-first, AcmeHealth = accuracy-first, MobileApp = latency-first, SandboxStart = balanced) and produce quick customer-facing one-pagers.

Tom (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 48h, require continuous eval checks and automated rollback if guardrails trip. Also add a small chaos test for prefix-cache consistency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created epic RDW-1500 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1500 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Mike+Linda => tech spec + bench plan by Tue EOD; Anna => customer one-pagers + pilot commitments; Tom => SLO guardrails + dashboards. We'll run a quick prioritization workshop Wed 9am. Ping here if blockers. :calendar: :+1:
